Blade.descEn: The half-vampire Daywalker Blade hunts vampires in the underworld to protect humanity, engaging in a bloody war against the vampire empire.
Blade.impactEn: Pioneer of the dark universe in Marvel films.

X-Men.descEn: As tensions rise between mutants and humans, Professor X's X-Men face off against Magneto's Brotherhood of Mutants in their first major battle.
X-Men.impactEn: Established the mutant concept and sparked the superhero film revival.

Blade II.descEn: To combat a deadlier new breed of vampire mutants, Blade must form a fragile alliance with the vampire lord.
Blade II.impactEn: The outbreak of a vampire mutant crisis.

Spider-Man.descEn: After being bitten by a mutated spider, Peter Parker gains powers and must balance his personal life while fighting the evil Green Goblin.
Spider-Man.impactEn: With great power comes great responsibility.

Daredevil.descEn: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock becomes the fearless Daredevil at night, battling criminals and the Kingpin on the streets of New York.
Daredevil.impactEn: Early attempt at a street-level hero film.

Hulk.descEn: Bruce Banner, exposed to lethal gamma rays, transforms into a powerful green monster when angry.

X2: X-Men United.descEn: Colonel Stryker plans to use Professor X to eliminate all mutants, forcing the X-Men to ally with Magneto.
X2: X-Men United.impactEn: Mutants face extinction by the human military.

Blade: Trinity.descEn: Vampire progenitor Dracula awakens, and Blade teams up with human Nightstalkers for the final battle to decide the fate of their species.

Spider-Man 2.descEn: Peter struggles with his dual identity as hero and ordinary man while facing the deadly threat of his mentor-turned-foe, Doctor Octopus.
Spider-Man 2.impactEn: One of the best superhero films in history.

Elektra.descEn: Resurrected from the dead, Elektra becomes a cold-blooded assassin, but a job to protect a father and daughter leads her to betray her employer.
Elektra.impactEn: The female assassin's rebirth and redemption.

Fantastic Four.descEn: Four young people are transported to a dangerous parallel universe, where their bodies undergo incredible mutations. They must learn to harness their new powers to save Earth.

X-Men: The Last Stand.descEn: A mutant cure is developed, while Jean Grey becomes Dark Phoenix, leading to the most brutal war among mutants.
X-Men: The Last Stand.impactEn: Phoenix Force awakens, causing a major split in mutant society.

Ghost Rider.descEn: Stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to a demon to save his father, transforming into a fiery Ghost Rider who punishes evil at night.

Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfe.descEn: The mysterious Silver Surfer arrives on Earth, heralding the coming of Galactus. The Fantastic Four must uncover his secret to save the planet.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfe.impactEn: Introduces the concept of a cosmic devourer.

Spider-Man 3.descEn: An alien symbiote amplifies Peter's dark side. He must overcome his inner demons and face the combined threat of Sandman and Venom.

Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance.descEn: Johnny Blaze, hiding in Eastern Europe, must protect a boy from the devil to break his curse.
Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance.impactEn: Spirit of Vengeance battles in Europe.

Captain America: The First Avenger.descEn: Brooklyn youth Steve Rogers receives a super-soldier serum and becomes Captain America. He thwarts Hydra's plot and crashes into the ice to save civilians, remaining frozen for 70 years.
Captain America: The First Avenger.charsEn: Captain America, Peggy Carter, Red Skull
Captain America: The First Avenger.impactEn: Space Stone appears; S.H.I.E.L.D. takes its early form.

Agent Carter Season 1.descEn: After Steve's sacrifice, Peggy secretly helps Howard Stark clear his name and deals with dangerous tech, showing the courage of a human hero.
Agent Carter Season 1.impactEn: SSR reorganizes, laying foundation for modern S.H.I.E.L.D.

Agent Carter Season 2.descEn: Peggy heads to Los Angeles to solve a case involving Zero Matter, facing Hollywood's dark side and a deadly new enemy.
Agent Carter Season 2.impactEn: Zero Matter (Dark Force) first introduced on Earth.

X-Men Origins: Wolverine.descEn: Logan and his brother Victor fight through centuries of war, finally caught in the Weapon X program where he receives adamantium and loses his memories.
X-Men Origins: Wolverine.impactEn: Reveals Wolverine's claws and amnesiac origins.

X-Men: First Class.descEn: Amid the Cold War nuclear threat, young Charles and Erik meet to found the X-Men, but eventually part ways due to differing ideologies.
X-Men: First Class.impactEn: Origin of the two mutant factions.

Captain Marvel.descEn: Amnesiac Starforce member Carol crash-lands on Earth, regains her memory and awakens Binary form, single-handedly repelling the Kree fleet.
Captain Marvel.impactEn: Inspires Fury to draft the Avengers Initiative.

Iron Man.descEn: After being kidnapped, Tony builds the Mark I armor to escape in a cave, returns to shut down his weapons division, and publicly declares 'I am Iron Man.'
Iron Man.impactEn: MCU's seminal film; starting point of the armor tech tree.

Iron Man 2.descEn: Facing government pressure and palladium poisoning, Tony synthesizes a new element with Fury's help and teams up with Colonel Rhodes to defeat Whiplash.
Iron Man 2.charsEn: Iron Man, Black Widow, War Machine
Iron Man 2.impactEn: Black Widow formally introduced; new element resolves palladium poisoning.

The Incredible Hulk.descEn: Banner transforms into Hulk due to gamma ray experiments, flees globally seeking a cure, and finally battles the mutated 'Abomination' in New York.
The Incredible Hulk.impactEn: Showcases Hulk's power; starting point for military superpower control.

Thor.descEn: Thor is stripped of his power and exiled to Earth. With Jane's help, he learns humility, reclaims Mjolnir, and foils Loki's usurpation plot.
Thor.impactEn: Expands MCU to the Nine Realms; Hawkeye's debut.

The Avengers.descEn: Loki steals the Tesseract to conquer Earth. Fury urgently activates the Initiative; six heroes synchronize in the Battle of New York to repel the Chitauri army.
The Avengers.impactEn: First assembly of the six; Thanos smiles behind the scenes.

The Amazing Spider-Man.descEn: Peter gains superpowers while investigating his parents' disappearance and engages in a deadly fight with the mutated Lizard professor.

Iron Man 3.descEn: Post-New York, Tony suffers PTSD. Facing the Extremis crisis, he destroys all his armors, proving he is still Iron Man.
Iron Man 3.impactEn: Tony completes his mental transformation; sets up Ultron.

The Wolverine.descEn: Logan retreats to Japan but gets entangled in a plot to steal his healing factor; he fights the Silver Samurai while losing his regenerative abilities.
The Wolverine.impactEn: Logan faces the brink of losing his healing factor.

Thor: The Dark World.descEn: Dark Elves awaken, aiming to use the Aether to destroy the universe. Thor defies his father and teams up with Loki for a tragic rescue mission across the Nine Realms.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1.descEn: A resurrected Agent Coulson assembles an elite team to handle supernatural events worldwide, while facing a full-scale Hydra infiltration.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1.impactEn: Expands the S.H.I.E.L.D. perspective post-Battle of New York.

Captain America: The Winter Soldier.descEn: Steve discovers S.H.I.E.L.D. is deeply infiltrated by Hydra. With Falcon's help, he confronts his brainwashed former best friend, the Winter Soldier.
Captain America: The Winter Soldier.charsEn: Captain America, Black Widow, Falcon, Winter Soldier
Captain America: The Winter Soldier.impactEn: S.H.I.E.L.D. collapses; Hydra's sleeper network is exposed.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2.descEn: S.H.I.E.L.D. goes fully underground. Coulson rebuilds as Skye awakens superpowers, revealing the long-hidden Inhumans on Earth.

X-Men: Days of Future Past.descEn: To stop a mutant genocide by Sentinels, Wolverine travels back to 1973 to alter history.

The Amazing Spider-Man 2.descEn: Peter battles Electro and Green Goblin, but suffers his greatest loss—failing to save Gwen.

Guardians of the Galaxy.descEn: Star-Lord steals an orb and reluctantly allies with four outlaws, who ultimately band together to save Xandar.
Guardians of the Galaxy.impactEn: The Power Stone appears; Thanos's cosmic threat emerges.

I Am Groot Season 1.descEn: Animated shorts follow Baby Groot's cute, mischievous adventures among the Guardians across the galaxy.

I Am Groot Season 2.descEn: Baby Groot's new interstellar trouble-making journey, even accidentally finding the Guardians' childhood keepsakes.

Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2.descEn: Star-Lord meets his celestial father Ego, who plans to consume the universe. Yondu's sacrifice teaches him true fatherhood.
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2.impactEn: Introduces Celestials; solidifies found family bonds.

Daredevil Season 1.descEn: Blind lawyer by day, devil by night, Matt Murdock begins a brutal confrontation with the Kingpin, the crime lord controlling Hell's Kitchen.
Daredevil Season 1.impactEn: Establishes the dark order of Hell's Kitchen.

Jessica Jones Season 1.descEn: A super-powered private investigator with PTSD, Jessica is forced to face the nightmare who once used mind control to destroy her life: the Purple Man.
Jessica Jones Season 1.impactEn: Delivers a desperate experience of psychological thriller and mind control.

Avengers: Age of Ultron.descEn: Tony's activation of a defense project causes Ultron to go rogue. The Avengers pay a heavy price to stop the apocalyptic threat of Sokovia rising and falling.
Avengers: Age of Ultron.impactEn: The Mind Stone creates Vision; Sokovia is destroyed.

Ant-Man.descEn: Ex-con Scott puts on a suit that shrinks his body, pulling off a heist to stop Pym particles from falling into the greedy Yellowjacket's hands.
Ant-Man.impactEn: Introduces Pym particles and the Quantum Realm.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3.descEn: A Terrigen crystal leak awakens Inhumans worldwide. S.H.I.E.L.D. must contend with ATCU oversight and HYDRA controlled by the ancient Inhuman Hive.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3.impactEn: Inhuman outbreak and mysterious alien origins.

Daredevil Season 2.descEn: With Kingpin in prison, the extreme Punisher goes on a killing spree. Meanwhile, ex-girlfriend Elektra's return drags Matt into the Hand's conspiracy.
Daredevil Season 2.impactEn: The Hand's plot emerges; the bloody vigilante arrives.

Luke Cage Season 1.descEn: With an unbreakable body, Luke Cage tries to lie low in Harlem but is forced to stand against local gangsters.
Luke Cage Season 1.impactEn: Rise of a super-powered hero in Harlem's black community.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4.descEn: The team encounters the Ghost Rider and faces the crisis of the Darkhold and the Framework, a virtual world created by android Aida.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4.impactEn: Intertwined Darkhold magic and AI threats.

Deadpool.descEn: Mercenary Wade Wilson undergoes an illegal experiment for cancer, gaining immortality at the cost of his face. He breaks the fourth wall and becomes Deadpool on a path of revenge.
Deadpool.impactEn: Breaking the fourth wall, a groundbreaking R-rated hero.

X-Men: Apocalypse.descEn: The first mutant Apocalypse awakens after millennia, aiming to destroy humanity and rebuild order. The young X-Men must unite against this god-like villain.

Iron Fist Season 1.descEn: Missing for 15 years, the billionaire's son returns to New York with the mystical martial art 'Iron Fist' from K'un-Lun, seeking to reclaim his family's company and eliminate dark forces.
Iron Fist Season 1.impactEn: Full-scale war between K'un-Lun martial arts and the Hand.

The Defenders.descEn: Four solitary New York street heroes are forced to ally against the Hand's ultimate plot to destroy the city underground in Manhattan.
The Defenders.charsEn: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, Iron Fist

Captain America: Civil War.descEn: The Sokovia Accords ignite a civil war among the Avengers. Zemo uses the truth of Bucky's murder of Tony's parents to fuel internal conflict.
Captain America: Civil War.charsEn: Captain America, Iron Man, Black Panther, Spider-Man
Captain America: Civil War.impactEn: The Avengers split over ideology; Black Panther and Spider-Man debut.

Black Widow.descEn: On the run after the war, Natasha confronts her dark past, reunites with her 'fake family,' and destroys the Red Room controlling agents.
Black Widow.charsEn: Black Widow, Yelena Belova, Red Guardian
Black Widow.impactEn: The Red Room falls; Yelena Belova as the second Black Widow appears.

Black Panther.descEn: T'Challa inherits the throne but faces his cousin Killmonger for the crown. He must awaken the Black Panther's power and decide Wakanda's future of isolation.
Black Panther.impactEn: Wakanda reveals its vibranium technology to the world.

Spider-Man: Homecoming.descEn: Post-war, Peter tries to prove himself but uncovers the Vulture trafficking alien weapons. He learns he's a hero even without the suit.
Spider-Man: Homecoming.impactEn: The common people's revenge against Stark's tech monopoly.

The Punisher Season 1.descEn: Frank thinks his revenge is over, but behind his family's tragedy lies a deeper military and CIA conspiracy.

Doctor Strange.descEn: After crippling his hands, Strange studies magic at Kamar-Taj. He uses a time loop to force Dormammu's retreat, becoming Earth's magical guardian.
Doctor Strange.impactEn: The Time Stone is revealed; magical multiverse opens.

Logan.descEn: In 2029, mutants are nearly extinct. An aging Logan with fading healing powers fights his last battle to protect a young mutant girl.
Logan.impactEn: The ultimate tragic elegy of a hero's twilight.

Legion Season 1.descEn: Professor X's son David is diagnosed with schizophrenia, until he discovers the voices and visions are actually his incredibly powerful mutant abilities.
Legion Season 1.impactEn: A stunning psychological masterpiece in the X-Men universe.

Inhumans.descEn: After a military coup, the Inhuman royal family must flee their home Attilan on the moon and seek refuge on Earth in Hawaii.
Inhumans.impactEn: Lunar Inhuman royalty's exile on Earth.

The Gifted Season 1.descEn: An ordinary couple discovers their children have mutant abilities and are forced to flee government capture, joining an underground mutant network.
The Gifted Season 1.impactEn: Mutant underground resistance after the X-Men's disappearance.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5.descEn: Agents are mysteriously transported to a future broken Earth space station, struggling to return to the present and break the time loop curse caused by Quake.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5.impactEn: Breaking the time loop, warning of Thanos' arrival.

Jessica Jones Season 2.descEn: Jessica tries to return to normal life but is forced to investigate the mysterious experimental organization that gave her powers, uncovering painful family wounds.
Jessica Jones Season 2.impactEn: A deep dive into the painful origin of superpowers.

Luke Cage Season 2.descEn: Now a Harlem celebrity, Luke encounters a new weapon that can pierce his skin, forcing him to choose between law and dark methods.
Luke Cage Season 2.impactEn: Power shift for the kingpin of Harlem's underworld.

Iron Fist Season 2.descEn: Danny protects New York, but his former brother Davos seeks to take the Iron Fist power and enforce extreme justice on the city.
Iron Fist Season 2.impactEn: Stripping and passing on the power of the dragon.

Daredevil Season 3.descEn: After escaping death, Matt's faith is shattered. Kingpin manipulates his release, controls the FBI, and creates a fake Daredevil to wreak havoc.
Daredevil Season 3.impactEn: Kingpin reclaims power, a perfect finale.

Thor: Ragnarok.descEn: Hela shatters Mjolnir. Thor reunites with Hulk on Sakaar, realizing Asgard is its people, and lets his home be destroyed to defeat Hela.
Thor: Ragnarok.impactEn: Asgard's destruction directly leads to Thanos' arrival.

The Punisher Season 2.descEn: Frank tries to lay low but is drawn into a conspiracy while protecting a teenager; his disfigured nemesis Jigsaw returns with endless rage.

Jessica Jones Season 3.descEn: Facing a highly intelligent serial killer, Jessica must track him down while dealing with a complete break with her best friend Trish over their conflicting views on justice.
Jessica Jones Season 3.impactEn: The final curtain of the Netflix street-level universe.

Legion Season 2.descEn: Returning after a year trapped in a mysterious orb, David finds his former allies have allied with the Shadow King, plunging him into deep confusion.
Legion Season 2.impactEn: Further distortion of the psychic dreamscape.

The Gifted Season 2.descEn: The underground mutant organization splits over ideological differences. Radicals led by Polaris join the extreme group called the Inner Circle, aiming to establish a mutant nation.
The Gifted Season 2.impactEn: Increased conflict between two mutant factions.

Deadpool 2.descEn: Deadpool encounters Cable, a cybernetic soldier from the future. To protect a chubby mutant kid, he assembles a highly unreliable X-Force.
Deadpool 2.impactEn: Time travel concept used for gags.

Venom.descEn: Reporter Eddie unexpectedly bonds with the alien symbiote Venom. Despite mutual disdain, they gradually work together to fight the evil Life Foundation.
Venom.impactEn: Foundational work for Sony's Spider-Man Universe (SSU).

Ant-Man and the Wasp.descEn: Scott and Hope venture into the Quantum Realm to rescue the original Wasp. In the post-credits scene, the Snap occurs, trapping Ant-Man in the quantum space.
Ant-Man and the Wasp.impactEn: Deep exploration of the Quantum Realm, laying groundwork for the Endgame reversal.

Avengers: Infinity War.descEn: Thanos's army sweeps across the universe collecting Infinity Stones. The fractured heroes resist desperately but suffer defeat. The snap becomes the most desperate moment in film history.
Avengers: Infinity War.charsEn: Full MCU cast, Thanos, Black Order
Avengers: Infinity War.impactEn: Thanos snaps, wiping out half of all life in the universe.

Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.descEn: Brooklyn teen Miles becomes the new Spider-Man and accidentally triggers a multiverse collision, teaming up with Spider-People from other universes.

Legion Season 3.descEn: David, now a destroyer, builds his own cult. To fix everything, he seeks help from a mutant who can time travel, intending to rewrite history.
Legion Season 3.impactEn: Traveling through time to change his own dark fate.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6.descEn: After Coulson's death, the team splinters. Some head into deep space to find the missing Fitz, while others on Earth fight Sarge, an alien predator with Coulson's face.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6.impactEn: Facing alien invasion and cosmic exploration.

Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7.descEn: To prevent the Chronicoms from erasing S.H.I.E.L.D.'s history, the team travels back to the 1930s and journeys through various eras of Marvel history, culminating in an epic and emotional finale.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7.impactEn: A perfect conclusion, the timeline finally closed its loop.

Avengers: Endgame.descEn: Five years after the Snap, the heroes time-travel to steal the Infinity Stones. After devastating sacrifices, they reverse the Snap and bring light back to the universe.
Avengers: Endgame.charsEn: Original Avengers, Captain Marvel, Ant-Man, Thanos
Avengers: Endgame.impactEn: Iron Man's sacrifice, Captain America's retirement, half of all life returns.

Loki Season 1.descEn: A variant Loki who escaped with the Tesseract is arrested by the TVA and ultimately witnesses the collapse of the timeline and the uncontrollable birth of infinite parallel universes.
Loki Season 1.impactEn: The Sacred Timeline breaks, the multiverse explodes.

What If...? Season 1.descEn: From the perspective of the Watcher outside time, the series explores wild parallel worlds born from minor deviations in key events.
What If...? Season 1.charsEn: The Watcher, Captain Carter, Doctor Strange Supreme
What If...? Season 1.impactEn: Shows the infinite possibilities after the multiverse's explosion.

WandaVision.descEn: Devastated by grief, Wanda uses magic to create a fake sitcom reality in Westview, eventually unleashing the ultimate power of chaos magic in despair.
WandaVision.impactEn: Wanda awakens as the Scarlet Witch, powerful enough to destroy the universe.

Dark Phoenix.descEn: During a space rescue, Jean is struck by a mysterious cosmic force that makes her the most powerful mutant but also causes her to lose control.
Dark Phoenix.impactEn: The final chapter of Fox's X-Men main universe.

The New Mutants.descEn: Five young mutants are held captive in a secret asylum, forced to confront their past sins and awakening terrifying powers.

Venom: Let There Be Carnage.descEn: Eddie and Venom face the bloody hunt of the serial killer symbiote Carnage. In the post-credits scene, they briefly transported to the main universe.
Venom: Let There Be Carnage.impactEn: The post-credits scene briefly teleports them to the MCU main universe.

Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Ring.descEn: The reclusive Shang-Chi is forced to confront his father Wenwu, who controls the Ten Rings, and ultimately resolves the crisis in Ta Lo, becoming a new generation Avenger.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Ring.impactEn: The Ten Rings send a mysterious signal into deep space, expanding the mythological storyline.

The Falcon and the Winter Soldier.descEn: After the return from the Snap, Sam struggles with race and responsibility, finally taking up the Vibranium shield, while Bucky seeks redemption for his Winter Soldier past.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier.impactEn: Sam officially becomes the new Captain America.

Spider-Man: Far From Home.descEn: After Endgame, Peter is deceived by Mysterio's illusions during a school trip to Europe. In the post-credits scene, Mysterio frames Peter and reveals his secret identity to the world.
Spider-Man: Far From Home.impactEn: Peter's identity is exposed, setting the stage for multiverse crises.

Eternals.descEn: Immortal aliens who have secretly lived on Earth for millennia defy their creator, the Celestial Arishem, to protect humanity from being sacrificed.
Eternals.impactEn: Reveals Earth's role as a Celestial egg, expands cosmic lore.

Spider-Man: No Way Home.descEn: Peter asks Doctor Strange to cast a spell that goes wrong, bringing villains from other universes. Guided by predecessors, he chooses to erase all memories of himself from the world.
Spider-Man: No Way Home.charsEn: Three Spider-Men, Doctor Strange, Green Goblin
Spider-Man: No Way Home.impactEn: Three generations unite; Peter Parker is forgotten by everyone.

Morbius.descEn: A biochemist with a rare blood disease becomes a vampire after trying a dangerous experimental treatment.
Morbius.impactEn: Further blurs the boundary between Sony's Universe and the MCU.

Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madn.descEn: Doctor Strange protects America Chavez from the corrupted Scarlet Witch across the multiverse, witnessing the Illuminati's fall and an incursion.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madn.impactEn: Triggers an incursion, an extinction-level multiverse crisis.

Hawkeye.descEn: During Christmas, Clint Barton is haunted by his past while training Kate Bishop. They are targeted by the new Black Widow and Kingpin.
Hawkeye.charsEn: Hawkeye, Kate Bishop, Kingpin, Yelena Belova
Hawkeye.impactEn: Second-generation Hawkeye takes over; Kingpin returns as a crime lord.

Moon Knight.descEn: A museum gift shop employee with dissociative identity disorder discovers he is the avatar of the Egyptian moon god Khonshu and must balance his identities to stop a cult.
Moon Knight.impactEn: Introduces ancient Egyptian gods into the MCU.

Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.descEn: After T'Challa's death, Wakanda grieves. Faced with war from the vibranium-powered underwater kingdom Talokan, Shuri takes up the Black Panther mantle to protect her nation.
Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.impactEn: Talokan emerges as a new power; a new Black Panther rises.

Echo.descEn: Maya Lopez returns to her roots to confront her past and her father figure Kingpin, ultimately breaking ties with him. Daredevil makes a cameo in a street fight.
Echo.impactEn: Kingpin plots a run for mayor of New York.

She-Hulk: Attorney at Law.descEn: Bruce Banner's cousin gains superpowers and becomes a lawyer-hero. This courtroom comedy breaks the fourth wall and features a new-costume Daredevil.
She-Hulk: Attorney at Law.impactEn: Breaks the fourth wall; legal framework for superhumans is established.

Ms. Marvel.descEn: Muslim teen Kamala Khan gains superpowers from a heirloom quantum bangle, uncovering her mutant heritage.
Ms. Marvel.impactEn: First explicit mention of 'mutant' gene in MCU.

Thor: Love and Thunder.descEn: Jane Foster, terminally ill, wields Mjolnir to become Mighty Thor. They journey to stop Gorr from wishing all gods dead at Eternity.

Werewolf by Night.descEn: Black-and-white horror homage: monster hunters compete for a relic, but a deadly werewolf lurks among them.
Werewolf by Night.impactEn: Launches Marvel's supernatural monster universe (Midnight Sons).

The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Spec.descEn: To give Star-Lord a memorable Christmas, Mantis and Drax kidnap his favorite Earth star Kevin Bacon.

Loki Season 2.descEn: Facing the time loom's overload, Loki learns ultimate sacrifice and endures the weight of all timelines as a mortal.
Loki Season 2.impactEn: Loki becomes the God of Stories, reshaping the World Tree.

What If...? Season 2.descEn: New variant heroes dive into altered fate nodes for unexpected adventures in a crazier multiverse.

Madame Web.descEn: Paramedic Cassandra awakens precognition after an accident; she must protect three spider-powered teens from deadly pursuers.

Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse.descEn: Miles travels the multiverse, meeting an elite team of Spider-People, but clashes over saving the world vs. his family.

Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania.descEn: The Ant-Family falls into the quantum realm and confronts the exiled tyrant Kang, master of time technology.
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania.impactEn: Kang Council issues multiversal war warning.

Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.descEn: To save Rocket, his brutal past is uncovered. A tearful farewell marks the end of the original Guardians.

Secret Invasion.descEn: Nick Fury returns to Earth to confront the deep infiltration of global political leadership by shape-shifting Skrull rebels, a spy war where no one can be trusted.
Secret Invasion.impactEn: Earth's leadership infiltrated by aliens, triggering a crisis of trust.

The Marvels.descEn: Three light-based heroes forced to team up due to entangled powers. Fixing a spacetime rift, Monica makes the sacrifice of being stranded in the X-Men alternate universe.
The Marvels.charsEn: Captain Marvel, Ms. Marvel, Monica Rambeau
The Marvels.impactEn: Spacetime rift opened, Monica stranded in the X-Men universe.

Venom: The Last Dance.descEn: Eddie and Venom pursued by the military and facing a full-scale invasion from symbiote hordes from their home planet; the duo's final curtain call.

Kraven the Hunter.descEn: Russian aristocrat Sergei, attacked by a lion during a hunt, gains beast-like strength and instincts after his blood merges, becoming the ultimate hunter.
Kraven the Hunter.impactEn: Origin of a classic Spider-Man villain.

Deadpool & Wolverine.descEn: To save a dying timeline, Deadpool crosses into the Void and brings back a regret-filled Wolverine variant, staging a blood-soaked rescue mission.
Deadpool & Wolverine.impactEn: Fox X-Men universe legacy seamlessly merged into mainline.

Agatha All Along.descEn: Depowered Agatha forms a non-mainstream coven and walks the deadly Witches' Road, ultimately revealing the boy beside her as Wanda's reincarnated son.
Agatha All Along.impactEn: Wanda's son Billy returns in a new body, magic narrative deepens.

Captain America: Brave New World.descEn: New Captain America Sam Wilson caught in an international crisis, facing President Ross intent on militarizing superheroes and the mutated Red Hulk.
Captain America: Brave New World.charsEn: Captain America (Sam Wilson), President Ross, Leader
Captain America: Brave New World.impactEn: Adamantium triggers global conflict, Red Hulk born.

Daredevil: Born Again.descEn: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock finds his arch-nemesis Kingpin using legal means to run for NYC mayor. The highest-stakes street-level cat-and-mouse game will be brutal.
Daredevil: Born Again.impactEn: New York's dark political landscape completely reshaped.

Thunderbolts*.descEn: A group of morally compromised former villains/anti-heroes forced by the government into a suicide mission, accidentally awakening the god-tier power of the Sentry.
Thunderbolts*.impactEn: Void core 'Sentry' appears, grey area power reshuffled.

The Fantastic Four: First Steps.descEn: In a retro-future 1960s parallel universe, the First Family gains powers and must confront a terrifying cosmic entity that consumes entire planets.
The Fantastic Four: First Steps.impactEn: Parallel universe faces consumption, eventually merging into Avengers 5.
